title: VNTG Sears Camera Auto Zoom W/ Lens Model #202, F=80-200mm, 1:4.0, No. 830806727
descriptionText:
This vintage Sears camera lens is a great addition to any photography enthusiast's collection. With a focal length range of 80-200mm and a maximum aperture of f/22, it's perfect for capturing stunning shots. The lens is an autofocus type and is designed for use with a Sears brand camera.

The mount for this lens is shown in the pictures provided. It's made in Korea, Republic of and is a great choice for anyone looking to add a high-quality lens to their collection. Whether you're a professional photographer or just starting out, this lens is sure to impress.
